title: Turning See Financial Data OFF asks you to also turn off the settings that depend on it
custom_preconds:
1. Open the role editor for a custom role.
  2. The role has See Financial Data ON.
  3. The role has Part sales View, Create & Edit and Delete all ON.
  4. The role has Invoicing & payments View, Create & Edit and Delete all ON.
custom_steps:
1. In the Cross-Cutting Toggles card, turn See Financial Data OFF.
  2. Look at the confirmation dialog that appears.
  3. Read the list of dependent settings it names.
  4. Choose to continue, then look at the Part sales and Invoicing & payments boxes and the Order parts toggle.
custom_expected:
Turning See Financial Data OFF does not silently untick the dependent settings.

A dialog titled 'Disable See Financial Data?' appears (buttons Cancel and Disable) telling the user the settings that rely on See Financial Data will be turned off.

It names the dependent settings that are currently on: Invoicing & payments, Part sales, Order parts, and View and Manage AP/AR Data.

Choosing Disable turns off those dependent settings (Part sales View/Create & Edit/Delete, Invoicing & payments View/Create & Edit/Delete, and Order parts).

Choosing Cancel leaves See Financial Data ON and changes nothing.
viu_status: Blocked-UI behavior; 'Disable See Financial Data?' modal now present in build (was a prior FAIL) — recommend live re-test
evidence: FinancialDataDisableConfirmModal ('Disable See Financial Data?', Cancel/Disable) is now wired into the build (PermissionEditor) — the disable prompt appears implemented (RUN331 had this as a FAIL). Dependent-clear behavior + exact body list need the role editor driven live.
